title: Frothy
summary: FROTH'Y, adjective 1. Full of foam or froth, or consisting of froth or light bubbles. 2. Soft; not firm or solid. 3. Vain; light; empty; unsubstantial; as a vain frothy speaker; a frothy harangue.
